identity.addresses: Oosterdoksstraat 4 (BAG logies verblijfsobject 0363010002005568, nevenadres); 5 verblijfsobjecten in the pand
identity.what: the DoubleTree by Hilton Amsterdam Centraal Station on the Oosterdokseiland between the railway and the Oosterdok: the hotel block with its top storeys (the skybar storey on the 44 m piece), the Starbucks corner and the restaurant terraces on the Oosterdok; DoubleTree signage on the entrance glazing in the w02-21 crop, the hotel named on en.wikipedia (Oosterdokseiland)
identity.notThis: the OBA Oosterdok (separate pand, already modelled) is not drawn; the OSM building parts the brief listed (w1487606275 ... w453809679, 'college' w779659694) do not lie on this pand: they are the blocks further east on the island. The hotel's own OSM parts are w1486076092-108 and w1512730512-517, all inside the BAG ring and suppressed. No architect is named in the open sources checked (nl/en Wikipedia, BAG); none is claimed.
